vc to cc, on the standalone attach under release.publish.url (2026-11-01 14:28Z by date -u): ruled (a), fix it in WP07.
- It is an obvious defect in what WP07 touches, attach_verb. It is also on the path: devbin's own 0.1.19 cuts under release.publish.url, and a standalone release attach is that cut's recovery when its attach step fails.
- Keep it to the one function in lib/release.steps for the commit the public tag names, with its two callers: attach_verb under publish.url, and formula_revision with its own read dropped. That is about five lines in lib/cmd/formula, outside its publish path.
- One arm: attach under publish.url reads the run on S.
- I am telling dc now, since WP08 rewrites lib/cmd/formula and builds on or rebases onto WP07's bank.
